items.title: Albert Nicholas Interview, 1972-06-26
items.q: Oh, yes. I knew Johnny Dodge all through the years.

ctx.x: What about somebody like Johnny Dodge? Did you ever see him there?

Oh, yes. I knew Johnny Dodge all through the years. When I was 12, 13 years old, I used to hear him at Uptown at Miss Cores along with Ory's, the kid Ory and things like that. I was a kid, but I always admired his playing. I don't think he'd take any lessons with any teachers down time. He had a unique style of his own. He was very popular. Yeah. Liked him very much.
Was he your age? No, he's older than me.

items.title: Albert Nicholas Interview, 1967-02-09
items.q: And Johnny Dodds was playing with Orris and he really amazed me. He was my idol at the time.

ctx.x: Like I was in your early days when you were first starting up playing. Yeah. The guys you used to listen to most. Oh. Have perhaps influenced you? Many. The guys from the Kings. Particularly Clare. Well, I tell you. When I was a kid, 14 years old in New Orleans, I used to go up on Sundays to hear Kid Orris Band. He was playing at Miss Coors Lawn. It was a penny party in those days for the kids, you know.

And I used to go up on Sundays to hear Kid Orris Band. And he was playing at Miss Coors Lawn. 10 o'clock at night. And Johnny Dodds was playing with Orris and he really amazed me.
